Reference Notes & FAQ

How much does Payoneer charge to withdraw to a local bank account?

Payoneer typically charges up to 2% above the mid-market exchange rate when withdrawing to a local currency bank account, or a fixed fee (often $15) for USD wire withdrawals.

Are Payoneer-to-Payoneer transfers free?

Receiving payments from another Payoneer customer balance is generally free, while receiving ACH bank debit payments in USD typically carries a 1% fee and credit card payments carry ~3%.
